name: Carboplatin + Gemcitabine
cyclesNote: First-line for cisplatin-ineligible metastatic urothelial carcinoma; typically 4-6 cycles, then reassess for switch-maintenance avelumab if no progression. Carboplatin is used only in the metastatic (non-curative) setting, not peri-operatively.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Carboplatin/gemcitabine is a cytotoxic backbone that is not biomarker-restricted. It is the standard platinum option for cisplatin-ineligible metastatic urothelial carcinoma (inadequate renal function, performance status, hearing, or neuropathy).

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: carboplatin plus gemcitabine is a moderate-emetic-risk combination; give a moderate-emetic-risk antiemetic regimen before chemotherapy.

supportiveCare: Carboplatin dosed by the Calvert formula to a target AUC; verify the GFR estimate before dosing.
CBC before each dose (gemcitabine day 8 is frequently held or reduced for cytopenias).
Monitor cumulative myelosuppression, especially thrombocytopenia, over successive cycles.
Carboplatin hypersensitivity risk rises after multiple cycles - watch for infusion reactions.
monitoring: renal function before each cycle (for Calvert AUC dosing)

doseModificationRules.text: Hold or reduce gemcitabine on day 8 for significant neutropenia or thrombocytopenia per protocol; obtain clinical review.

drugs.name: Carboplatin
drugs.notes: Carboplatin AUC 4.5 IV on day 1 of a 21-day cycle, dosed by the Calvert formula (dose in mg = AUC x [GFR + 25]). An AUC of 5 is an accepted alternative in fitter patients. Dose per standard cisplatin-ineligible urothelial practice (Standard Guidelines / DeVita / Harrison, general reference).

provenance.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy, cisplatin-ineligible first-line

drugs.name: Gemcitabine
drugs.notes: Gemcitabine 1000 mg/m2 IV on days 1 and 8 of a 21-day cycle. Day 8 is frequently held or reduced for cytopenias. Dose per standard urothelial practice (Standard Guidelines / DeVita / Harrison, general reference).

provenance.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy, cisplatin-ineligible first-line
